verdict.rationale: Trello is a kanban-style project and task management SaaS, not a coding agent or source-control tool, so requiring cryptographic signing of AI-authored commits is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Trello authoring or signing git commits; its AI feature covers writing and editing card content.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can require AI-authored commits to be cryptographically signed with my SSH or GPG key
